name: Andaman Islands
description: A remote archipelago in the Bay of Bengal known for world-class coral reefs, dense tropical rainforest, and clear turquoise water. The islands suit travellers willing to deal with limited connectivity and modest infrastructure in exchange for genuine natural beauty. Not ideal for luxury seekers or those wanting a packed cultural itinerary — the pace is slow and distances between islands are real.
nearest_railhead: There is no rail connection. Nearest railhead on mainland India is Chennai Central or Howrah (Kolkata), both approximately 1,200 km away.
nearest_airport: Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair (IXZ)

attractions.name: Radhanagar Beach
attractions.description: Widely rated among Asia's best beaches, Radhanagar offers a long arc of white sand backed by intact forest with shallow, calm water good for swimming. Sunsets here are genuinely spectacular, though the beach fills up in peak season and basic facilities are limited.

attractions.name: Elephant Beach
attractions.description: A snorkelling and shallow-dive site reached by a 30-minute ferry or a 45-minute forest trek from Havelock. Coral cover is patchy after bleaching events but still the most accessible reef for first-time snorkellers, with rental gear available on the beach.

attractions.name: Cellular Jail National Memorial
attractions.description: The colonial-era prison used by the British to exile Indian freedom fighters, now a national memorial in Port Blair. The structure and its history are genuinely sobering; the daily sound-and-light show recaps the independence movement but is crowded and somewhat theatrical.

attractions.name: North Bay Island
attractions.description: A short ferry ride from Port Blair, North Bay is the main spot for glass-bottom boat rides, snorkelling, and introductory scuba sessions for day-trippers. It gets very crowded midday; the coral near the jetty has suffered from boat traffic but the underwater visibility is still decent.

attractions.name: Ross Island (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Island)
attractions.description: The former British administrative headquarters, now a small island overrun by roots and forest reclaiming the colonial ruins. A 20-minute ferry from Port Blair; wandering the roofless churches, bakeries, and bungalows with deer grazing among them is one of the more atmospheric experiences near the capital.

attractions.name: Natural Bridge (Howrah Bridge), Neil Island
attractions.description: A coral rock formation shaped by wave action into a natural arch at the western tip of Neil Island, best seen at low tide. It requires a short walk on uneven coral rock and is one of the few geological curiosities in the archipelago worth the detour if you are already based on Neil.

attractions.name: Laxmanpur Beach, Neil Island
attractions.description: Neil Island's longest beach, quieter than anything on Havelock and with reliable sunset views across a wide tidal flat. The beach is shallow and sandy, making it comfortable for walking and paddling without strong currents.

attractions.name: Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park, Wandoor
attractions.description: A protected marine park 29 km from Port Blair with over a dozen islands and some of the Andamans' healthier coral ecosystems. Day trips run from Wandoor jetty; Jolly Buoy Island (open only in alternating six-month seasons) has arguably better snorkelling than North Bay with fewer crowds.

attractions.name: Baratang Island Limestone Caves
attractions.description: Stalactite-filled limestone caves reached via a government-convoy road through Jarawa tribal reserve, followed by a mangrove creek boat ride. The journey is half the experience; the caves themselves are modest but the mangrove passage is genuinely beautiful and the trip is unlike anything else in the islands.

attractions.name: Saddle Peak, Diglipur
attractions.description: The highest point in the Andaman archipelago at 732 m, accessible by a well-marked forest trail through North Andaman's dense rainforest. This is a genuine hidden gem — few tourists make the 12-hour overnight journey from Port Blair, but birders and trekkers who do find excellent canopy forest and cool temperatures at the top.
